sectors.trend: Gold and rare earths names outperform on discovery pipeline; Gateway, Auric, Lindian, True North, PLC, ZhongNuo all advancing exploration/offtake milestones. Iron ore and coal muted amid energy transition debate.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GWP.AX, AUC.AX, PLC.AX) offer relative safety; rare earths (LND.AX) benefit from supply-chain diversification away from China. Coal (BHP.AX, WBC.AX coal segment) faces policy headwinds from One Nation vs. transition cost debate.

sectors.trend: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs pressures NIMs and credit losses. CBA (CBA.AX) faces reputational hit from 13-year inactive-card fee saga. RBA rate-hike uncertainty weighs on valuations.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face margin compression risk if RBA hikes further; credit cycle deterioration in housing could elevate NPLs. Trust tax changes may reduce fee income.

sectors.trend: Persian Gulf tanker fires spike oil risk premium; Chinese solar overtakes coal capacity; energy transition costs 'running off the rails'. Coal plant retention debate (One Nation) adds policy noise.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from oil volatility; renewables names face cost overruns. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) supported by supply disruption.

sectors.trend: Qantas (QAN.AX) faces dual pressure: strike vote and cost-cutting (allowance cuts, luggage fees). Costco service shutdown signals consumer spending caution. Bathla (property) near collapse.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX elevated execution risk; consumer discretionary under pressure. REITs and property developers (Bathla) face liquidity stress.

sectors.trend: Nvidia AI narrative intact ($89B catalyst); Citi recommends buying tech dip; September 'fear month' but AI stocks show resilience. Amazon hit by FTC lawsuit.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global tech strength supports sentiment. Monitor for spillover into CSL.AX (health-tech) and SSG.AX.

sectors.trend: House prices face potential 10% correction; mortgage stress at 18-year highs; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with population growth.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (VCG.AX, DGP.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure. Construction (WBC.AX, WES.AX) may see delayed project pipelines.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower over 1–3 months. RBA rate-hike uncertainty, mortgage stress, and geopolitical shocks (Persian Gulf, Venezuela) cap upside. Gold and energy names provide relative outperformance. Qantas strike risk and property developer liquidity issues create idiosyncratic volatility. September seasonality adds caution.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses hikes and housing stabilises. Structural themes in critical minerals, gold, and AI/tech offer growth. However, productivity 'bad to worse' and fiscal credibility concerns cap re-rating potential. Chinese solar overtaking coal accelerates energy transition investment but raises cost-overrun risks.
